title: Understanding the Scatter Plot
text: Observe the scatter plot carefully. Notice the trend of the data points. How does the trend relate to the slope of a linear regression line?

title: Mean-Centering Effect
text: Mean-centering the data affects the intercept of the regression line but not the slope. Consider how this might influence the test MSE.

title: Choosing the Parameter
text: Given the negative trend in the data, which parameter is likely to fit the data better and achieve a lower test MSE?
choices: Both achieve the same test MSE
